title: Greek-Style Pan-Seared Saganaki with Feta
description: A classic Greek dish featuring crispy pan-seared saganaki topped with crumbled feta cheese and a sprinkle of turmeric. Serve as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the saganaki and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
3. Remove the saganaki from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
4. Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese over the saganaki.
5. Sprinkle the turmeric over the feta cheese.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
